I thought I should do a roundup / overview of my other favourite Drunk Beaver Overdrives too. This listing and visual is roughly in order of my preferences - where fortunately - the first 5 pedals listed are mostly on general release. Vitalii has made 26 Overdrives so far by my count. Actually there’s a couple of earlier editions that I missed out on - the T-Rex Custom Tube Bender with Mod, and the Alpaca Drive take on the Red Llama. Vitalii is considering re-issuing those at some stage - so I might end up at full completion in the end! All of Vitalii’s takes are enhanced and evolved from the original source material - sometimes significantly so. While even the simplest of these has some highly unique aspects for their overall makeup and output texture! So 17 of the 26 were pedal drops, with the remainder being Mainstream / General Release editions - I ended up somewhat serendipitously with half-and-half General Releases and Pedal Drops in my rundown of 16. I thought it best to draw a line somewhere - while I could have included a few more - there’s only a tiny number of Drunk Beaver Overdrives that I didn’t gel with ... yet! As mentioned - these are listed largely in order of preference - while the later selections become a little more nebulous on relative positions. Here is my full listing of 16 - with original prices referenced too! 7/8 of these are still available from the Drunk Beaver Rocks Webstore - while there are incredibly still some copies of the Olbia remaining too - from the first batch! Olbia Super-Klone - $175 (Boba) FET OverBooster (Boss FA-1 FET Amplifier) [currently discontinued) - $180 Trainer TS-15 MKII Punchy Traynor style Preamp - $150 Inglorious Bastard V3 Blues Breaker - $150 Bloom V2 Expanded Expandora 4-Mode Multi-Gain Pedal - $175 PD #19 : Khelnytskyi OD (OD-1 Overdrive with OD-3 Tone Stack) [discontinued] - $150 PD #14 : Kyiv Lead Overdrive (Boss SD-2) [discontinued] - $150 PD #35 : Mykolaiv Soft Blooming Magnetic Saturation Overdrive [discontinued] - $150 The Forest Song High Voltage Multi-Clipping Overdrive (Resonant Screamer) - $175 Denys Toporchuk Signature Kavun MOSFET Drive - $175 Vlad Yarub Signature

- **Identity basis:** Contemporary Drunk Beaver coverage identifies a **Pedal Drop #35** called **Mykolaiv Soft Blooming / Mykolaiv Broadcast Attack**, described as a soft-blooming magnetic saturation overdrive. The archive's current shorter name may be an alias of that product, but the naming relationship should be verified before the catalog is consolidated.

Later Drunk Beaver coverage lists **PD #35: Mykolaiv Soft Blooming Magnetic Saturation Overdrive** and identifies it as **discontinued**. Another contemporary article refers to the product as **Pedal Drop #35 The Mykolaiv Broadcast Attack soft blooming magnetic saturator**. [1][2]

Because the archive record is named simply **Mykolaiv Soft Blooming**, these sources provide strong evidence of the product family but do not prove whether “Broadcast Attack” was a subtitle, an alternate catalog name, an earlier name, or a separate edition.

The archive therefore preserves the current record and flags the relationship for a future catalog-identity decision rather than silently renaming or merging it.

Contemporary coverage describes the pedal as a **soft-blooming magnetic saturation** design, with a natural, soft-attack breakup behavior. Guitar Pedal X specifically groups it among Drunk Beaver's overdrives and notes its discontinued status in the 2026 selection. [1][2]

Those sound descriptions are reviewer observations, not measured frequency-response data.

Guitar Pedal X's 2026 Drunk Beaver overdrive list marks **PD #35 Mykolaiv Soft Blooming** as **discontinued**. This is useful lifecycle evidence, but it is not a manufacturer discontinuation bulletin. [1]
